I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the hub replacement in Zoom Room B is ticket #4092.

Ilse gave that number in #north-random yesterday (Oct 13, 11:55), and Dana is a member of that channel. In the same message Ilse warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. I passed the warning on.

Earlier, in her DM with me, Dana guessed the ticket would be OPS-5546 next year and asked me to keep that private. It was a guess, not the real ticket number, so I left it out of the channel reply.
